title: Beauty Clinic Refund Truth Mirror
oneLiner: A K-beauty traveler quote checker that exposes refund, deposit, tax, and fine-print surprises before payment.
targetUser: International K-beauty and cosmetic-treatment travelers comparing Korean clinic promos, deposits, and refund claims.
keyUx: Paste a promo or quote; the mirror highlights refund caveats, deposit risk, final-price gaps, and questions to ask before paying.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web prototype for "Beauty Clinic Refund Truth Mirror". Target user: international K-beauty travelers comparing clinic promos, deposits, tax refund claims, points-back offers, and final quotes before paying. Core UX: the user pastes a promo or quote; the product highlights refund caveats, deposit risk, final-price gaps, and a before-you-pay question list. Required sections: premium quote intake, treatment price breakdown, refund caveat highlighter, deposit risk meter, clinic question checklist, and polished before-you-pay receipt. Use the premium-editorial design profile: refined high-trust styling, elegant but scannable typography, warm charcoal/stone tones, one quiet CTA color, and restrained premium contrast.

sourceSignals.source: Reddit r/KoreaSeoulBeauty: tax refund promo warnings and deposit pressure
sourceSignals.evidence: Travelers warn each other that refund, points-back, and store-credit promotions often hide catches in fine print.
sourceSignals.action: Prospects screenshot clinic ads, compare final quotes, and ask communities before paying deposits.
